# 0w.lat
> Fast, client-side, privacy-first web utilities.

## Tools
- [JSON Converter](https://0w.lat/tools/json-converter): In-browser JSON to TypeScript interfaces & Pydantic models.
- [URL Shortener](https://0w.lat/tools/url-shortener): Fast URL shortening with custom vanity slugs.
- [QR & Wi-Fi Card](https://0w.lat/tools/qr-code): Client-side QR generation and printable Wi-Fi sign-in sheets.
- [Secret Sharing](https://0w.lat/tools/secret-share): End-to-end AES-GCM encrypted self-destructing pastes.
- [Webhook Catcher](https://0w.lat/tools/webhook-catcher): Inspect incoming HTTP webhooks in real-time via WebSockets.
